card.name: Words just before a conditional clause
card.fires_on: Short linking words (in, by, and, be) or a digit in label warnings, at a spot where the sentence could continue with 'if' or a similar condition. Most often in repeated boxed-warning sentences.

modes.description: The word 'in' after 'reserve concomitant prescribing of these drugs'.
modes.example: Because of these risks, reserve concomitant prescribing of these drugs<< in>> patients for whom alternative treatment options are inadequate
